## Observation
What failed or appears inconsistent?

## Reproduction
Commit/version, Python version, operating system, exact command, and input hashes.

## Evidence

## Interpretation
Does this affect a measurement, a statistical inference, or a physical claim?
Do not include credentials, private correspondence, or raw copyrighted material.
